title: 出海匠 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接你的出海匠开放平台账号。按 WorkBuddy Token 模式，API Key 仅保存在当前用户本机，并在连接 MCP 时注入请求头。
description_en: Connect your Chuhaijiang Open Platform account. In WorkBuddy token mode, the API key is stored locally for the current user and injected into MCP request headers when connecting.
docLabel: 如何获取出海匠 API Key？
docLabel_en: How do I get a Chuhaijiang API Key?

fields.label: 出海匠 API Key
fields.placeholder: 登录出海匠后，在开发者门户创建，格式为 sk_live_…
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in to Chuhaijiang, then create one in the Developer Portal; it starts with sk_live_
fields.description: 用于调用出海匠开放平台。请勿粘贴账号密码或其他平台密钥。
fields.description_en: Used to call the Chuhaijiang Open Platform. Do not enter your account password or keys from other services.
